title: Euler's Method Step-by-Step Numerical Approximation
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Use Euler's method with step size Delta x = 0.1 to approximate y(0.2) for the initial value problem dy/dx = x + y with y(0) = 1.

steps.title: First Step: From x_0 = 0 to x_1 = 0.1
steps.explanation: Evaluate slope at (0, 1) and advance by Delta x = 0.1.

steps.title: Second Step: From x_1 = 0.1 to x_2 = 0.2
steps.explanation: Evaluate slope at (0.1, 1.1) and advance to x = 0.2.
